[[File:ExplosiveRange.png|20px|Explosion Range]]5 (Explosion) |speed = 12 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Bomber Elf''' is the third unit that spawns from the [[Elf Camp]]. It spawns when the [[Elf Camp]] is at Levels 2-3. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. It has a spawnrate of 8 seconds. The '''Bomber Elf''' will collide with enemies until it dies. Upon death, the present that it is holding will explode and deal a large amount of damage to anything caught in the explosion. The '''Bomber Elf''' is replaced by the [[Gift Bomber]] for the Level 4 [[Elf Camp]]. ==Appearance== The '''Bomber Elf''' has pale skin and brown hair. It wears a green shirt with a brown belt and red details, red hat with goggles on top, dark green pants and brown shoes. It holds a black and yellow present, which explodes upon death. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:BomberElf.png|175px]] |[[File:ChocolatierBomberElf.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} |{{Color|Valentines2026|Chocolatier}} |- !Obtained From |[[Christmas 2025 Crate]] |[[Valentines 2026 Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Bomber Elf''' is great for hordes of enemies that spawn initially during the round, like the [[Heavy]], [[Hidden]], [[Mystery]] or [[Breaker2]]. **It can also deal quite a bit of damage to stronger enemies like the [[Normal Boss]] or [[Elite Abnormal]]. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Bomber Elf''' will spawn per Level 2-3 [[Elf Camp]]. It will go down a random path. *The '''Bomber Elf''' can be somewhat useful against [[Hidden]]s and [[Fallen Soul]]s if none of your other towers have hidden detection. **The '''Bomber Elf''' cannot collide with [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemies like [[Soul]]s, though they can still be caught in its explosion. *The '''Bomber Elf''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Elite Abnormal]]. The explosion, however, will have its damage reduced. *The '''Bomber Elf''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and an '''Bomber Elf''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly defeated and its explosion is unlikely to hit anything. ==Trivia== *The {{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} skin is based on the [[Bomber Elf (Cold Ambush)|Bomber Elf]] enemy from [[Cold Ambush]]. *While the '''Bomber Elf''' has a range of 3, it cannot deal any form of damage, aside from collision damage. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''21 December 2022''' -
